{{Quote|This is Raden. I've come to deliver news to the mighty Darga. With all due respect, I require an audience.|Warrick Raden|<ref name="AWH">{{DoD|A Wretched Hive (adventure)}}</ref>}}'''Warrick Raden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] criminal who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Raden worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Darga Jiramma Mionne]] and he carried messages and extorted money on Darga's behalf. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to Cato Neimoidia in search of Darga and they located Raden and a group of Darga's thugs inside a ruined warehouse. Raden refused to show the agents to [[Darga the Hutt's palace|Darga's residence]] and he and his thugs attacked them. However, the agents defeated Raden and forced him to lead them to Darga's palace. Raden introduced the agents to Darga and the Hutt recruited them into his organization. However, Darga believed that Raden had betrayed him and the Devaronian was subequently dragged to the palace's dungeons by two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards.
